content:
Generate a detailed 20-panel storyboard image first (with numbered timestamps, camera notes, and motion guides like speed lines/trajectory arcs), then feed that storyboard into Seedance 2 to animate it into a sports-anime trailer.

In your storyboard prompt, explicitly specify CAMERA LANGUAGE (e.g., low-angle fisheye, tracking side shots, overhead perspective, close-up hand focus, cinematic zoom-ins) to predefine the camera movement Seedance 2 should follow.

Add VISUAL EFFECTS directives (speed lines everywhere, impact burst scribbles, motion flow arrows, sweat particles, light streak reflections, final energy explosion) in the storyboard prompt to carry anime motion cues into the Seedance 2 video.

Lock the look by prompting a monochrome storyboard style (black & white ink sketch, rough linework, construction lines visible, dynamic perspective grids) so Seedance 2 preserves a consistent manga storyboard aesthetic during animation.

Describe the action as a progression montage (control → speed → domination → finishing move) with concrete basketball moves per beat (cross behind, between-legs, hesi burst, stepback, euro step, reverse layup, catch-and-shoot 3PT) to give Seedance 2 clear sequential motion to animate.

ストーリーボードのプロンプトでは、CAMERA LANGUAGEを明確に指定してください（例：低角度のフィッシュアイ、追跡サイドショット、オーバーヘッド視点、手元のクローズアップ、シネマティックなズームイン）Seedance 2が従うべきカメラの動きを事前に定義します。
